notes:
v0.6.13: recipe catch-up to v0.6.12. The image overlay was already at v0.6.12 (lxmd.service, meshchatx.service, reticulum-meshchatx pipx venv, lxterminal apt package, prepare-*-dirs.sh helpers, all in place), but the human-readable BUILD.md recipe didn't reflect those additions. A fresh flash from the stock ReticulumHF base + this overlay would have produced a v0.6.12-current box because the overlay files were correct, but the operator following BUILD.md by hand would have missed: lxterminal in the apt list, lxmd.service and meshchatx.service in the systemd-units cp block, the prepare-*-dirs.sh invocations between the cp block and Step 6, lxmf and reticulum-meshchatx in the pipx install list (was still pointing at the obsolete reticulum-meshchat git clone), and lxmd.service + meshchatx.service in the systemctl enable --now list. Also added: a "pin to current tag" step right after the git clone (Step 4.1a) so a fresh flash produces a box at the right launcher version, and a /launcher-status health check in Step 7 that uses the launcher's own canonical endpoint. README.md updated: pre-built image is no longer claimed to be on github releases (the v0.5 release was a one-off; subsequent builds publish the recipe but not a binary). g90-image/README.md header date updated.

After this release, g90f1r2 re-flash is a clean story: flash ReticulumHF base → run BUILD.md Step 3-7 → box is at v0.6.12-current.
